_README: PLACEHOLDERS: Marius will rewrite all of these. Every day below is a draft task drawn from what exists in the game, not final story. Edit freely: day = door number; title = short name; text = what the Lantern (Lykta) says; hint = a small extra line (can be empty); done = what Lykta says when the task is done; target = {x,z,name} in world coordinates (null = no arrow; name is what the compass shows, use 'downtown' not the real town name); kind = story/explore/race/bowl/coins (just a label); done_when = how the game knows it is done: {type:'near',radius:12} walk within radius metres of the target, {type:'race',race:'spark'|'jet'} finish that race (leave race out for any race), {type:'bowl'} finish a bowling game, {type:'coins',n:10} collect n coins since the door opened, {type:'flag',flag:'__WITCH_GONE'} a window flag is truthy, {type:'talk'} just listen to Lykta, {type:'manual'} only window.__LANTERNGUIDE.complete() finishes it. Target can use {find:'Bowlinghallen'} instead of x,z to look the place up in the search index. Note: this file is public, so days later than today can be read by anyone who opens it; keep spoilers vague or move the file out before launch. Day 24 also has 'later': timed Lykta lines [{at:'afternoon'|'dusk'|'night', text}] for the finale (storydata 4 Nov; the finale wiring reads them). target.live (playmail): 'mailstand' = the game moves x,z onto the builder mailstand the mailbox hotspot uses, 'tree' = onto the Christmas tree (window.__TREEPOS); x,z stay the fallback.

days.title: Welcome downtown
days.text: Welcome downtown! Find the Christmas tree on the square.
days.hint: It stands in the middle of town, by the town hall.
days.done: Found it. Big tree, small town, and I think it just blinked. The first door is open!

days.title: Down the hill
days.text: Hop on a kick-sled and ride the spark race down Hamrevegen!
days.hint: Walk to the start sign and press G.
days.done: What a ride!

days.title: Strike!
days.text: Go to Bowlinghallen and play one whole game of bowling.
days.hint: Rent a lane at the counter, then press G at a lane.
days.done: Nice rolling!

days.title: Voices in the cold
days.text: Go to the church and listen. Somewhere downtown, carolers are singing.
days.hint: Follow the sound of singing. Stand still near the church doors and let it wash over you.
days.done: Beautiful singing. Stay a while: the church is the warmest place in town tonight. Tomorrow a door about coins opens.
days.chip: Go to the church and listen to the carolers

days.title: Pocket money
days.text: Collect 10 coins along the road into town. Every krone counts at Christmas.
days.hint: Gold coins glow on the main road. Follow the pin and walk through them.
days.done: Cha-ching! Pockets a little heavier. Tomorrow: a visit up in the hills.
days.chip: Collect 10 coins on the main road (follow the pin)

days.title: Tipi village
days.text: Visit Camp Botnan and look around the tipi village. The folks up there have something for you.
days.hint: It is up in the hills east of town. Walk right in among the tipis. They have an old, rattly thing that lets you leave the ground.
days.done: Cozy up there! The tipis keep the wind out and the fire keeps the dark away. And look: a battered old jetpack, handed over by the tipi folk. It mostly works. Mostly. Press X to put it on. Tomorrow there is post for Chris.
days.chip: Visit the tipi village at Camp Botnan (a gift waits there)

days.title: Mail from home
days.text: Something is rattling in Chris's building. Go home and open the mailbox by the road. A letter from Mamma should be waiting.
days.hint: The mailbox is the black box by the road in front of Chris's house. Look at it and press G.
days.done: A letter from Mamma, and cookies! Keep it secret: someone downstairs is listening.
days.chip: Open the mailbox at Chris's house (G)

days.title: Under the floorboards
days.text: The witch's flat is not what it seems. Find the trapdoor behind Chris's house and take a quiet look. It was locked yesterday.
days.hint: Stay quiet. She hates noise. The trapdoor lies in the yard behind the house.
days.done: I knew it. A dungeon.
days.chip: Find the trapdoor behind Chris's house

days.title: The big globe
days.text: Find Globen, the giant landmark out on the hill. Walk, drive, whatever you like. Follow my arrow. I have a feeling there is something up there for a person who likes to jump.
days.hint: It is past the tipi village. Walk right up to it. They say a pair of wings is lying around on top of the world. Afterwards, jump off the hill.
days.done: What a view! A big round thing on a hill, and it is looking back at us. And look: wings, just lying there. Jump off the hill and see what happens.
days.chip: Walk or drive up to Globen, the big globe on the hill (wings are waiting up there)

days.title: Top of the rock
days.text: Climb Orresteinen, the giant rock above Fedafjorden, far out west. It is a long way. Take a car, or a jetpack if you are brave.
days.hint: Follow my arrow and keep going until you are on top of the rock.
days.done: Top of the world! Do not look down. Do look around.
days.chip: Climb Orresteinen, the giant rock far to the west (car or jetpack)

days.title: Baking Day
days.text: Baking Day. Mamma's cookie recipe needs flour, butter, ginger spice, syrup and eggs, from different shops, and some are sold out. Then bake in Chris's kitchen: press G at the stove. Please do not let it burn. I cannot smell, and I am still worried.
days.hint: Start at the bakery on Nesgata. Buy, mix, roll, cut, bake. Then take the batch where it is needed.
days.done: Not burnt. Almost. Now take it where it is needed.
days.chip: Bake Mamma's cookies: buy flour, butter, ginger spice, syrup, eggs, bake at Chris's stove (G)

days.title: Cookie monster
days.text: The witch has been eating all the cookies. The trapdoor behind Chris's house is open. Go down, take the old lantern from the hook by the stairs (press G), and walk into the cauldron room. End this.
days.hint: Click to hit her when she is close. When it goes dark she comes back from behind: turn around and hit her. If she wins, go down and try again.
days.done: The spell is broken! That was never a witch. That was a neighbour with a very bad month. Go and get the parcel where she fell.
days.chip: Go down the trapdoor behind Chris's house, take the lantern (G), find the witch

days.title: Make it shine
days.text: Decorate Chris's house. Now it will stay up! Stand in the front yard and press G: window stars, lights outside, the wreath. Put them all up.
days.hint: Press G in the front yard of Chris's house. Stars, lights, wreath: go wild.
days.done: Beautiful. The stones are warm. Not the stones, I mean everything. Is that your doing?
days.chip: Decorate Chris's house (G in the front yard): stars, lights, wreath

days.title: Light the lights
days.text: Walk around town and light up Christmas. Start by the tree on the square.
days.hint: Go to the big tree by the town hall and stand under it. The whole town glows tonight.
days.done: Everything glows!
days.chip: Go to the Christmas tree on the square and watch the town light up

days.title: Look up
days.text: Astronomers said a fun night. I have looked up the word fun. They are using it differently. After dark, go to the frozen river, stay on the ice, and look up.
days.hint: Stay on the ice after dark until something falls. It will not be snow.
days.done: That was not a fun night. That was a fireball.
days.chip: After dark, go to the frozen river, stay on the ice and look up

days.title: The last parcel
days.text: Open the mailbox at Chris's house. The last parcel from Mamma should be here.
days.hint: The mailbox is the black box by the road. Look at it and press G.
days.done: Cookies at last! Men in black coats are up at the crater now. Do not go near. ...Go near, but carefully.
days.chip: Open the mailbox at Chris's house (G): Mamma's last parcel is in it

days.title: Hill walk
days.text: Hike up to Hamrevarden and see the town from above.
days.hint: Warm clothes help. Follow my arrow up the hill.
days.done: Cold and beautiful. I keep feeling counted. Please be warm somewhere.
days.chip: Hike up to Hamrevarden and look at the town from above

days.title: Two hats
days.text: Red hats, blue hats, one very old argument. Gammel-Rød waits in the red cave and Mor Blå in the blue one, and both blame the other for the grey footprints. Bring them to one table at the church. I would knock their heads together, but I have no hands.
days.hint: Look at the footprints in both caves, hear both chiefs out, then meet them at the church table.
days.done: They are still arguing, but at one table. That counts.
days.chip: Talk to both nisse chiefs (G), look at the footprints, bring them to the church

days.title: The Night Wing
days.text: The Night Wing is ready. Fly the jetpack ring race out toward the crater on Nonskarknuten. Rings, a crater, and a car with opinions. Fly.
days.hint: Walk to the start sign on the riverbank and press G. Rings, jetpack, fuel. If you miss a ring, turn around. The prize is 64 rockets. You already have the jetpack and the wings, so use them both.
days.done: You made it to the rim. Do not look down into the crater.
days.chip: Fly the jetpack ring race: walk to the start sign and press G

days.title: The crater
days.text: Something up on the mountain is moving, slowly, toward town. Drive up to the crater on Nonskarknuten and have a look. Then run.
days.hint: Stay on the flank, away from the light beam. Get within a few steps of the crater and that is enough.
days.done: It is slow. I do not like slow things that do not stop.
days.chip: Drive up to the crater on Nonskarknuten and have a look. Then run!

days.title: Longest night
days.text: Fifteen small fires. We make them, or we are dark. Light the cairns on the hills (press G beside one with your lantern), then get to Bowlinghallen. It is the only place that stays warm.
days.hint: When it gets dark, stay near me and run for Bowlinghallen. Every fire you light buys us an earlier dawn.
days.done: Safe and warm. Fifteen fires, and we kept the light.
days.chip: Light the cairns on the hills (G), then get to Bowlinghallen before the dark

days.title: Slightly embarrassed lights
days.text: Check on someone. Anyone. Warm is a team sport. Wave at the neighbours in the gardens near Chris's house, and help the grey lost ones standing on the square: hold the lantern up and press G.
days.hint: Coins can wait. Bring a few for the cafe if you like.
days.done: Somebody smiled back. Warm is a team sport. And they closed the case, and nobody followed the cable. It is in your quests now: Follow the cable. Town hall, courtyard wall.
days.chip: Check on your neighbours: wave at the gardens near Chris's house (G), help the grey ones on the square

days.title: Lille julaften
days.text: Lille julaften. The dragon at Liland woke when the light went out. Make the gingerbread house anyway: press G at the stove in Chris's kitchen. Slowly. Then visit the church and say hello to everyone.
days.hint: Press T and type ginger and I will take you to the stove. You need the kit from Mamma's parcel, 3 candy and sugar.
days.done: Almost there. Tomorrow we find out what the dragon wants.
days.chip: Make the gingerbread house at Chris's stove (G), then say hello at the church

days.title: Christmas Eve
days.text: Whatever happens, we kept the light. Tonight has three stops, in this order: the dragon at the Liland tower (from 11:00), the candles at the graveyard (from dusk), then the tree on the square: press E there and Santa reads the Nice List.
days.hint: Press Y and I will show you the way to the next stop. Your Nice points plus your Julestemning decide who is the nicest.
days.done: Merry Christmas, Chris and Martin! The list has been read and the last door is open.

later.text: The Liland dragon is stretching. First stop: the tower, I will show the way. Press E there. Then the candles at dusk, then the tree.
The candles at the cemetery. Light one for everyone who is not here. Then go on to the tree and press E: Santa reads the list.
The Nice List. Your Nice points and your Julestemning, added together. Whatever it says, you were kind to someone. Probably. Go and see.

days.chip: Tonight: Liland tower, graveyard at dusk, then the tree (press E)
